days.title: Accettura Heritage and Nature
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: museo naturalistico
stops.detail: At the park's management headquarters, there is also a natural history museum, a botanical garden, laboratories, and an information center.

stops.name: area archeologica di Croccia Cognato
stops.detail: The Monte Croccia state anthropological reserve was then established to protect the archaeological area of Croccia Cognato, now inside the park, which preserves the remains of a prehistoric settlement of the ancient Lucanians, datable between the 6th and 4th centuries BC, found on the summit of the mountain of the same name.

stops.name: bosco di Montepiano
stops.detail: In the territory of Accettura there is also the Montepiano wood, an ancient turkey oak forest cultivated as a deciduous wood, which covers about 800 hectares.

days.title: Dolomiti Lucane Villages and Gorges
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Castelmezzano
stops.detail: The inhabited centers of Castelmezzano and Pietrapertosa themselves are extraordinarily picturesque, clinging to the rocky walls of the mountains that surround them and which, with their shapes, give rise to suggestive scenery and breathtaking landscapes.

stops.name: Pietrapertosa
stops.detail: As evidence of the importance that tree cults have in this part of the Lucanian Apennines, other May festivals or tree wedding ceremonies are also celebrated in Oliveto Lucano from August 10 to 12, in Castelmezzano on September 12 and 13, and in Pietrapertosa during the festivities for Saint Anthony of Padua in June.
